test_cases.title: Full refund of a three-tender sale follows exact reverse payment order

test_cases.title: SAP refund message for a full refund contains all six required fields with correct values
preconditions: Store S-0412, register REG-03
SAP endpoint or test stub up and recording received messages
Sale TXN-2027 on 2026-10-20: Line 1 Wireless Mouse $85.00, paid by Visa ending 1111 (card valid)
steps: 1. Start a refund and scan the receipt for TXN-2027
3. Confirm the refund and note the refund ID and time on the receipt

test_cases.expected: SAP message contains refundId equal to the receipt's refund ID, originalTxnId TXN-2027, amount 85.00, tenderType for Visa, storeId S-0412, and a timestamp matching the refund time on the receipt

test_cases.title: SAP refund message for a partial refund carries the partial amount

test_cases.title: SAP receives the refund message no later than 5 minutes after the refund

POS and SAP stub clocks synced

test_cases.expected: T1 minus T0 is 300 seconds or less; the message's timestamp field equals the refund time

test_cases.title: Refund message is delivered on the first retry after one SAP failure, with no error log
preconditions: SAP test stub set to fail the first send and accept the next one, logging every attempt
Sale TXN-2031 on 2026-10-20: Line 1 Keyboard $60.00, paid by Visa ending 1111 (card valid)
steps: 1. Refund Line 1 Keyboard ($60.00) on TXN-2031 and confirm
2. Check the SAP stub's attempt log for TXN-2031
test_cases.expected: SAP stub shows 2 attempts (1 failed, 1 accepted) for TXN-2031; no error log entry for TXN-2031

test_cases.title: Refund message is delivered on the third and last retry, with no error log
preconditions: SAP test stub set to fail the first 3 sends and accept the 4th, logging every attempt
Sale TXN-2032 on 2026-10-20: Line 1 Keyboard $60.00, paid by Visa ending 1111 (card valid)
steps: 1. Refund Line 1 Keyboard ($60.00) on TXN-2032 and confirm
2. Check the SAP stub's attempt log for TXN-2032
test_cases.expected: SAP stub shows 4 attempts (initial send + 3 retries), the 4th accepted; no error log entry for TXN-2032

test_cases.title: After 3 failed retries POS stops retrying and writes an error log entry
preconditions: SAP test stub set to fail every send, logging every attempt
Sale TXN-2033 on 2026-10-20: Line 1 Keyboard $60.00, paid by Visa ending 1111 (card valid)
steps: 1. Refund Line 1 Keyboard ($60.00) on TXN-2033 and confirm
3. Check the SAP stub's attempt log for TXN-2033
test_cases.expected: SAP stub shows exactly 4 attempts (initial send + 3 retries) and no 5th attempt; POS error log has exactly one entry for the failed refund message for TXN-2033

test_cases.title: No retries and no error log when the first SAP send succeeds
preconditions: SAP test stub set to accept every send, logging every attempt
Sale TXN-2034 on 2026-10-20: Line 1 Keyboard $60.00, paid by Visa ending 1111 (card valid)
steps: 1. Refund Line 1 Keyboard ($60.00) on TXN-2034 and confirm
2. Check the SAP stub's attempt log for TXN-2034
test_cases.expected: SAP stub shows exactly 1 attempt for TXN-2034; no error log entry for TXN-2034

open_questions: R2: Is day 30 after purchase inside or outside the window? A boundary test for a sale dated 2026-09-28 (test date 2026-10-28) will be added once this is answered.
R2: Are the 30 days calendar days in the store's local time zone, and is the purchase date counted as day 0?
R2: What should the POS show or offer when a refund is outside 30 days (hard block, store credit, manager override)?
R1: Can a cashier or manager ever override the refund tender (for example card sale refunded to cash)?
R3: For a partial refund on a split-tender sale, is 'reverse order' applied by filling the last tender up to its paid amount before moving to the earlier one (as assumed in TC-011 to TC-013)?
R3/R6: In a split-tender sale where one card is expired or closed, is only that card's portion converted to store credit?
R4: Does 'original amount' include tax? Are partial refunds allowed by quantity within a line, or only whole lines?
R5: Is the $500 limit checked per refund transaction or on the cumulative refunded total for the sale? Is it before or after tax?
R6: How does the POS learn that a card is expired or closed (card expiry on file, processor decline response, other)?
R7: What is the exact tenderType value for each tender, including store credit? For split-tender refunds, is one SAP message sent per tender or one for the whole refund?
R7: What is the required timestamp format and time zone, and is the 5 minutes measured from refund confirmation?
R8: Does '3 retries' mean 1 initial send + 3 retries (4 attempts, as assumed in TC-032/TC-033)? What is the interval between retries, and must retries also finish within the 5-minute window from R7?
R8: What must the error log entry contain, and is the refund still completed for the customer when the SAP send ultimately fails?
